EmailTemplate.subject: ON THE FLY: Why NACHA's changing regulations matter!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
NACHA, the National Automated Clearing House Association, governs the ACH network to ensure participants seamlessly complete transactions. With the deadline for its Account Validation Rule quickly approaching, organizations initiating consumer ACH debits via the internet or mobile devices will need to verify consumer account information for the first payment effective March 19th, 2021.
Join Flywire's CTO, David King, during the COHEAO webinar happening next Thursday, February 25th at 2 pm ET to explore specific changes, what you need to know, and how you can prepare for the NACHA Account Validation Rule, alongside additional changing regulations that lie ahead.
